title: cluster.yaml — 5-axis Talos cluster configuration
description: JSON Schema for the 5-axis cluster.yaml format consumed by talos/Makefile.lib. Validates shape only; cross-reference to Layer-C hardware-features registry enforced by make validate-schematics (Phase 1B).

strict_capability_merge.description: When true, capability patch conflicts (two capabilities patching the same JSON-pointer) are FAIL diagnostics instead of WARN. Default: false.

roles.description: Role identifiers mapped to role specifications.

architectures.description: CPU architecture identifiers mapped to architecture specifications.

infrastructure-platforms.description: Infrastructure platform identifiers mapped to platform specifications (Talos installer image profile).

hardware-platforms.description: Hardware platform identifiers mapped to platform specifications (SBC / server identity).

hardware-capabilities.description: Composite capability identifiers mapped to capability specifications. Each entry optionally lists the atomic Layer-C feature ids it requires.

propertyNames.description: Capability keys must consist of alphanumerics, dots, underscores, or hyphens only (no whitespace or shell-special chars).

nodes.description: Ordered list of node declarations. Each node binds exactly one value on each of the 5 axes.

patch-item.description: A single patch to apply to the Talos machine config. Supports two forms: inline JSON-pointer patch ({pointer, value}) or file-reference ({file: <path>}).

oneOf.description: Inline JSON-pointer patch: sets the value at the given RFC 6901 pointer in the machine config.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer identifying the target location (e.g. /machine/install/disk).

value.description: Value to set at the JSON-pointer location. May be any JSON type.

oneOf.description: File-reference patch: path to a YAML patch file applied via talosctl --config-patch @<file>. NOTE: placeholder_bindings (PLACEHOLDER -> yq-path in nodes/<n>.yaml) lives on the hardware-capability-spec, not on the patch-item — see $defs/hardware-capability-spec.

file.description: Relative path to a YAML patch file (relative to the talos base directory).

role-spec.description: Specification for a node role (e.g. controlplane, worker, gpu-worker).

patches.description: List of patch file paths applied to every node carrying this role.

default_extensions.description: List of Talos system extension URLs included for every node carrying this role.

arch-spec.description: Specification for a CPU architecture axis value.

compatible-infrastructure-platforms.description: Infrastructure platform ids this architecture is compatible with.

compatible-hardware-platforms.description: Hardware platform ids this architecture is compatible with. When present, nodes with this arch must use one of these hardware platforms.

infrastructure-platform-spec.description: Specification for an infrastructure platform axis value (installer image profile).

installer-profile.description: Talos installer image profile. SecureBoot variants are forbidden by AGENTS.md Hard Constraints (cause boot loops on this platform) and enforced via .github/workflows/hard-constraints-check.yml.

extensions.description: Talos system extension URLs contributed by all nodes using this infrastructure platform.

compatible-hardware-platforms.description: Hardware platform ids compatible with this infrastructure platform. When present, nodes using this infra platform must use one of these hardware platforms.

hardware-platform-spec.description: Specification for a hardware platform axis value (SBC / server identity).

extensions.description: Talos system extension URLs contributed by all nodes using this hardware platform.

hardware-capability-spec.description: Composite capability specification. requires_features optionally lists the atomic Layer-C hardware feature ids this capability comprises; omitting it means the capability has no Layer-C cross-reference requirement (cross-reference validation is then skipped for this capability in validate-schematics).

requires_features.description: List of atomic Layer-C hardware feature ids required to satisfy this composite capability.

extensions.description: Talos system extension URLs contributed when this capability is active on a node.

patches.description: JSON-pointer patches declaratively associated with this capability. NOTE: declarative-only in v0.5.x — argv-print.sh does NOT auto-compose these into the per-node patch list; consumers must include the patch file in the role's patches[] manually. Auto-composition lands post-v0.6.0 (see RELEASE-NOTES-v0.5.2.md, section Cap-patches composition). Duplicate pointers across capabilities still produce a conflict diagnostic at validate time.

placeholder_bindings.description: Map of PLACEHOLDER_NAME -> yq path under the nodes/<n>.yaml 'machine.*' subtree (e.g. machine.network.bridge.nic). At gen-configs time argv-print.sh resolves each binding against the per-node yaml; resolve-placeholders.sh substitutes ${PLACEHOLDER} tokens in any patch the role applies. Each placeholder name MUST be declared by exactly one capability the node uses (argv-print.sh emits binding-conflict otherwise). Field paths are charset-restricted to ^machine[.][A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$ to prevent yq-expression injection AND to scope reads to the machine.* subtree (no traversal into cluster.* or other root keys that nodes/<n>.yaml may carry).

node-spec.description: Single node declaration binding exactly one value on each of the 5 axes.

name.description: Unique node name (used as talosctl target and Make rule name).

role.description: Role id — must match a key in the top-level roles map.

arch.description: Architecture id — must match a key in the top-level architectures map.

infrastructure-platform.description: Infrastructure platform id — must match a key in the top-level infrastructure-platforms map.

hardware-platform.description: Hardware platform id — must match a key in the top-level hardware-platforms map.

hardware-capabilities.description: List of composite capability ids from the top-level hardware-capabilities map. Items must match the same charset as hardware-capabilities propertyNames. Canonical kebab-case form aligned with the top-level hardware-capabilities key.

hardware_capabilities.description: DEPRECATED ALIAS for hardware-capabilities (kebab-case). Accepted during the v0.5.4 grace window for migration compatibility; planned removal in v0.6.0. Equivalent in shape and semantics to hardware-capabilities; do NOT set both keys on the same node.

nic.description: Primary NIC name (placeholder variable NIC_NAME convention; Phase 1C refactor).
